driver_design_review: GO: diagnose the unresolved interval-width discrepancy with stored development fields and a linear response check; no new sampling or nonlinear PM evolution.
goal: Reliable CF4-informed 1-2 cMpc/h surroundings feeding a Local Group-only 0.3 cMpc/h zoom IC hierarchy. This diagnostic remains N32 and makes no resolution attainment claim.

inputs.tasks: all eight already generated development assignments in the posterior program

method.normalization: Compare the inference white-to-density transfer directly with installed PMWD linear_modes(a=1, real=True) on the same N32 white field; relative RMS tolerance 1e-10.
method.CIC: Approximate continuous CIC assignment amplitude product sinc(k_a*6/(2*pi))^2; does not include particle sampling aliases or nonlinear evolution.
method.block: Exact two-fine-node averaging amplitude product cos(k_a*3), with native-index phase exp(i*3*sum(k_a)); verify against explicit fine-grid embedding and block averaging.
method.Nyquist: Exclude coarse Nyquist planes from windowed candidates; retain a separate masked baseline so their removal is not confused with smoothing.
method.samples: Every fourth already stored white draw per chain, fixed in advance; compare the raw subsample with existing full-draw coverage as a sampling diagnostic.
statistics: coverage and standardized residual spread per candidate
same-seed linear-template correlation and residual RMS
truth power divided by candidate prior power for every mesh k shell
fraction of linear posterior draws below delta=-1
raw linear versus mass-weighted truth velocity correlation
method.interpretation: Filtering stored draws is sensitivity analysis, not a refitted posterior or calibration pass. No filter or phase is selected by its coverage. A linear-prior comparison is not ensemble simulation-based calibration.

static_source_findings: Truth is CIC-deposited N64 nonlinear mass and momentum, block-averaged to N32; velocity is momentum/mass.
Inference exports unsmoothed linear Fourier density and potential-flow velocity, while its positive tracer mean is exponential in that linear density.
Truth tracer mapping uses centered log(fine_density) and fixed population-total normalization; inference has free population amplitudes without the same normalization.
PMWD grid points begin at zero; later truth/tracer routines use cell-center coordinates. Native array-index alignment must be quantified before choosing a common physical coordinate convention.
deferred: fitting a spectrum correction to these truths
boundary: Driver closure review then user approval before another bundle. Fable/Opus audits waived for Astra.
